description: Land Title Settlement Department - Panaluwa (Block 01) Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520031 and other Land Parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land registration processes across multiple districts (Colombo, Galle, Hambantota, Gampaha). This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and land-related legal processes.
